dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I love our new apartment! Two bedrooms and a big kitchen!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈlʌv aʊr ˈnuː əˈpɑːrtmənt! ˈtuː ˈbɛdruːmz ənd ə ˈbɪɡ ˈkɪtʃən!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too! My old room was so small. Now let's talk about the housework.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː! maɪ ˈoʊld ˈruːm wʌz ˈsoʊ ˈsmɔːl. ˈnaʊ ˈlɛts ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈhaʊswɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. You love cooking, right? Can you make dinner?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. juː ˈlʌv ˈkʊkɪŋ, ˈraɪt? kən juː ˈmeɪk ˈdɪnər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. And can you do the dishes after dinner?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ənd kən juː ˈduː ðə ˈdɪʃɪz ˈæftər ˈdɪnər?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No problem. I'll do the laundry on Saturday, too. But I never do the ironing!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈprɑːbləm. aɪl ˈduː ðə ˈlɔːndri ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ, ˈtuː. bʌt aɪ ˈnɛvər ˈduː ði ˈaɪərnɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's OK. I'll do the ironing. I have a uniform for work.
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈduː ði ˈaɪərnɪŋ. aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈjuːnəfɔːrm fər ˈwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks! And do we have to make our beds every day?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ənd duː wiː ˈhæf tə ˈmeɪk aʊr ˈbɛdz ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In my family, we make our beds every morning.
dialogue.reading: ɪn maɪ ˈfæməli, wiː ˈmeɪk aʊr ˈbɛdz ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? I only make my bed when I have guests!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈmeɪk maɪ ˈbɛd wɛn aɪ ˈhæv ˈɡɛsts!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ha! OK. Your room, your rules!
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! oʊˈkeɪ. jʊr ˈruːm, jʊr ˈruːlz!
